title: WHO PreQualificaiton VaccineType  Display Values
description: Display values for WHO PreQualificaiton VaccineType  ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions. Keys are code fragments (the part after '#' in the canonical IRI). The full IRI can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code.

fhir:displays.description: Multilingual display values for ValueSet codes keyed by code fragment

^.+$.description: Display values for a specific code fragment by language

^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})?$.description: Display value in the specified language (ISO 639-1 code)

DTwP.en: Diphtheria, tetanus and (whole cell) pertussis vaccine (adsorbed)

DTwPHepBHib.en: Diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B and (+) Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate vaccine (adsorbed)

DTwPHib.en: Diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis and (+) Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate vaccine (adsorbed)

HPV.en: Recombinant human papillomavirus virus-like particle vaccine (types 16,18)

Hib.en: Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate vaccine

JE.en: Japanese encephalitis vaccine (live, attenuated) for human use

MMR.en: Measles, mumps, rubella combined vaccine (live, attenuated)

MenACYW135.en: Meningococcal conjugate vaccine tetravalent ( type A,C, Y, W-135)

bOPV.en: Poliomyelitis vaccines (bivalent live, oral, innactivated, type 1, 3)

dT.en: Diphtheria and tetanus vaccine (adsorbed, reduced diphtheria antigen content)

mOPV1.en: Poliomyelitis vaccines (monovalent oral, live, attenuated,  type 1)

mOPV2.en: Poliomyelitis vaccines (monovalent oral, live, attenuated,  type 2)

mOPV3.en: Poliomyelitis vaccines (monovalent oral, live, attenuated,  type 3)

nOPV2.en: Poliomyelitis vaccines (novel, oral, live, attenuated,  type 2)
